recPick.title: MasterClass launches “Understanding GLP‑1s and Weight Loss” — the science you should actually know right now
recPick.body: A brand‑new MasterClass just went live on September 3, 2026: “Understanding GLP‑1s and Weight Loss,” offering a legit crash course on the medications dominating wellness headlines. It’s worth your time if you’re trying to navigate the buzz around GLP‑1 prescriptions with clarity—straight from experts, not wellness influencers. The main trade‑off? It’s pitched at the curious—not clinicians—so it won’t replace a doctor’s advice. Plus, MasterClass isn’t cheap, especially if you’re already past their Labor Day discount window.
